problem:
The random variable $X$ has the following probability distribution.

| $x$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{X}(x)$ | $0.3$ | $0.4$ | $0.3$ |

Let $Y=2{X}^{3}+1.$ The distribution of $Y$ is given below.

| $y$ | $a$ | $b$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{Y}(y)$ | $0.3$ | $c$ | $d$ |

What is the value of $a+b+c?$

examples.problem:
The random variable $X$ has the following probability distribution.

| $x$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f_X(x)$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ | $0.3$ | $0.4$ |

Let $Y=\dfrac12X^2.$ The distribution of $Y$ is given below.

| $y$ | $0$ | $a$ | $b$ | $18$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f_Y(y)$ | $0.1$ | $c$ | $d$ | $0.4$ |

Find the values of $a,b,c,$ and $d.$
